title: Prompt/LLM Application Developer Roadmap
summary: A four-year engineering path focused on software engineering, LLM application development, AI/ML fundamentals, evaluation, deployment, and production systems.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 2026–2030 four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme. The first two years build programming and engineering foundations; Years 3–4 shift toward LLM applications, evaluation, deployment, internships, and a demonstrable portfolio.

blocks.text: Scholarships and fellowships

blocks.label: PMRF
blocks.text: Requires a qualifying PhD route at eligible institutions; a regular-college BCA route does not qualify directly. A 4-year engineering degree alone should not be treated as automatic eligibility.

blocks.label: Fulbright-Nehru Master's
blocks.text: Bachelor's degree with at least 55% and 3 years of full-time paid work.

blocks.label: DAAD
blocks.text: Master's requirements vary by programme; the supplied benchmark is about 7.5/10 CGPA or higher, English/German around B2, with two years' work experience preferred.

blocks.label: Sponsorship note
blocks.text: Employer-funded postgraduate study and scholarships have programme-specific conditions; confirm directly with the employer or funding body.

PhD routes

The durable skill is no longer prompt syntax alone. Build expertise in evaluating AI systems, selecting models, controlling reliability and cost, designing AI-enabled products, and leading engineering teams. Continue learning as model architectures, tooling and deployment practices change.
